description: We are 15-16 year old high-schoolers into ai, tech, software, startups, and much more.
summary:
We developed a interactive website, where young kids can learn about the history of the spacecrafts to obtain more research for the Moon and Mars. Inside of the website you can start by picking one of the two planets, which can give you an extremely interesting experience from the spacecrafts that were used during the former times to the spacecrafts that were used during the recent generations. The interactive site addresses what the machine was, what is had carried, what happened to it, and where it is now. This is important because it can give an understanding to the youth about the spacecrafts that NASA has developed and launched.



(github repo link: https://github.com/hempatelv6-beep/Mission-Reborn)
details:
1. It shows you the history of the spacecrafts of the Moon and Mars, and it includes the important details of each spacecraft. Such as how it was used during the mission and the specific parts that were used for the spacecraft.

2. Gives you fun facts of both planets and also the resources of the sites, that we have used.

3. You click on the Moon or Mars ➡ You scroll down and read about each spacecraft ➡ After each spacecraft is done, it gives you a quiz ➡ There is a final quiz for all spacecrafts combined for each planet and both combined ➡ After you move on the next planet ➡ Then your done

4. It gives the youth the foundation knowledge about the spacecrafts.

5. Java, CSS, HTML, Github, Claude

6. When we were discussing about the project, we thought of how the format and the aesthetics of the website should look like and how we should implement the information for the audience.


Github repo link: https://github.com/hempatelv6-beep/Mission-Reborn
